data: Apple delivered solid top-line expansion in fiscal 2022, with revenue rising 7.8% to $394.3 billion from $365.8 billion in fiscal 2021. Net income grew more slowly, up 5.4% to $99.8 billion in fiscal 2022 from $94.7 billion in fiscal 2021, which points to some margin pressure as profit lagged sales. Cash generation was the standout, with operating cash flow climbing to $122.2 billion in fiscal 2022 from $104.0 billion in fiscal 2021, comfortably exceeding net income. The balance sheet tells a more cautious story. Total assets were nearly flat at $352.8 billion in fiscal 2022 against $351.0 billion in fiscal 2021, while total liabilities rose to $302.1 billion from $287.9 billion. Cash and cash equivalents fell to $23.6 billion in fiscal 2022 from $34.9 billion in fiscal 2021, suggesting heavy capital deployment despite strong operating inflows.
